{{Character Infobox |color={{unova color}} |corecolor={{unova color light}} |bordercolor={{unova color dark}} |name=Amanita |jname=ショウロ |tmname=Shōro |image=Amanita Adventures.png |size=145px |caption=Amanita in [[Pokémon Adventures]] |gender=Female |relatives=[[Fennel]] (sister) |hometown=[[Striaton City]] |region=[[Unova]]| |eyes=Black |hair=Brown }} {{Character Infobox/Game |color={{unova color light}} |gen={{gen|V}} |games={{game3|Black and White|Black, White|s}}, {{B2W2|Black 2, White 2}} }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{unova color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |debut=''[[PS471|Battle in the Dreamyard]]'' }} |} '''Amanita''' (Japanese: '''ショウロ''' ''Shōro'') is the storage system creator of the [[Unova]] region, who lives in [[Striaton City]]. She is an expert in computing, creating a [[Pokémon Storage System]] that succeeded [[Bebe]]'s storage system. ==In the core series games== Amanita is introduced in [[Generation V]] as the [[Pokémon Storage System]] creator living in [[Striaton City]] in the [[Unova]] region. She developed Unova's storage system based on the previous designs of [[Bill]], [[Lanette]], and [[Bebe]]. In {{game|Black and White|s}}, the {{player}} first meets her in Striaton City, where she gives them a Box that can be accessed in their [[PC]]. She also tells the player about a new feature called the Battle Box, which can be used to store the player's {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} for battle. She has the player start out with 8 Boxes capable of holding 240 Pokémon. When all 8 Boxes have at least one Pokémon in them, the storage capacity is increased to 16 Boxes, holding 480 Pokémon. When all 16 of these Boxes have at least one Pokémon in them, the capacity is increased again to the maximum of 24 Boxes, holding 720 Pokémon. In {{B2W2}}, Amanita is found in [[Castelia City]], along with [[Fennel]]. They are located on the third floor inside the building across the street from the [[Castelia Gym|Gym]]. After the player has entered the [[Hall of Fame]], Amanita will give the player an {{p|Eevee}} she received from a friend in the [[Kanto]] region. ===Pokémon=== ====Gives away==== {{Pokémon |gen=5 |ndex=0133 |pokemon=Eevee |gender=male |type1=Normal |level=10 |ability=Anticipation |move1=Tackle|move1type=Normal|move1cat=Physical |move2=Tail Whip|move2type=Normal|move2cat=Status |move3=Sand-Attack|move3type=Ground|move3cat=Status |move4=Growl|move4type=Normal|move4cat=Status}} ===Quotes=== ===={{game|Black and White|s}}==== *If spoken to before receiving the C-Gear and Pal Pad :''"Are you a Trainer? {{color2|000000|Generation V}} |} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Black & White}}===== Amanita is the assistant and younger sister of [[Fennel]], a scientist who researches dreams and the energy they emit. Amanita first appears alongside Fennel in ''[[PS471|Battle in the Dreamyard]]'', where they encounter {{adv|Black}} and {{adv|White}}. They travel with Black and White to the [[Dreamyard]], where Black's {{p|Munna}}, [[Musha]], was held captive by a trio of {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s. After Black defeats the Grunts and rescues Musha, he lets Fennel acquire a sample of [[Dream Mist]] to be used for research. In ''[[PS511|Dream a Little Dream]]'', Amanita watches the {{un|Pokémon League}} tournament alongside Fennel and Professor Juniper. ====={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===== In ''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]'', Amanita stays at Fennel's house alongside Fennel, Professor Juniper, {{adv|Bianca}}, and [[Cedric Juniper]] to escape the [[Plasma Frigate]] freezing Unova's cities. There, Fennel reveals that after researching the Dream Mist for two years, she managed to discover another dimension known as the [[Pokémon Dream World]]. She hypothesizes that this may have been where Black went to after being sealed into the [[Light Stone]] two years ago. To confirm this, Fennel has White sent to the [[Entralink]], where the real world and Dream World are most connected. The operation proves to be a success as White manages to find and obtain the Light Stone. ====Pokémon==== =====Adopted===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Amanita |pkmn=Watchog |type1=Normal |img=Fennel Amanita Watchog Adventures.png |epnum=PS471 |epname=Battle at the Dreamyard |desc=This {{p|Watchog}} was used by Team Plasma to steal Black's {{p|Munna}}, [[Musha]]. Eventually, Black manages to retrieve Musha and uses him to defeat the Watchog. Later, it was adopted by Amanita and Fennel. None of Watchog's moves are known.}} ==Trivia== * Amanita states the Eevee given to her in {{B2W2}} was from a friend in the [[Kanto]] region. This person is most likely [[Bill]], as he gives an Eevee to the player character in [[Generation II]] and {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}, along with giving one to [[Bebe]] (who then gives it to the player) in {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{unova color}}; border:3px solid #{{unova color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{unova color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{unova color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{unova color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ショウロ ''Shōro'' | From 松露 ''shōro'' ({{wp|Rhizopogon roseolus|blushing false truffle}}), a fungus considered to be a delicacy in Japan |- | English | Amanita | From the mushroom genus ''{{wp|Amanita}}'' and possibly ''animation'' |- | German | Rubina | From ''Rhizopogon rubescens'' (synonym of the blushing false truffle) |- | European Spanish | Trufa | From ''trufa'' ({{wp|truffle}}) |- | French | Boletta | From ''bolet'' ({{wp|bolete}}), a type of mushroom |- | Italian | Mico | From the prefix ''mico-'' (equivalent to "{{wp|wiktionary|myco-|myco-}}", relating to fungi) |- | Korean | 솔이 ''Sol-i'' | From 송로 (松露) ''songno'' (truffle; literally "pine dew"), where the name may be formed from 솔 ''sol'' (pine) and 이슬 ''iseul'' (dew) |- | Chinese (Taiwan) | 松露 ''Sōnglù''[[Pokémon Adventures]] | rowspan="3" | From 松露 ''sōnglù / chùhnglouh'' (truffle) |- | Chinese (Hong Kong) | 松露 ''Chùhnglouh'' |- | Chinese (mainland China) | 松露 ''Sōnglù'' |- | Vietnamese | Shouro | Transcription of her Japanese name |} {{-}} ===Notes=== {{reflist|group=n}} ==Related articles== {{PCDevelopers|unova}} {{NPC|Unova|unova=yes}} {{Project CharacterDex notice}} [[Category:Black and White characters]] [[Category:Black 2 and White 2 characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters]] [[de:Rubina]] [[es:Trufa]] [[fr:Boletta]] [[it:Mico]] [[ja:ショウロ]] [[zh:松露]]
